title: Supplemental provisions respecting bye-laws
text:
483. Supplemental provisions respecting bye-laws.—(1) Any power to make bye-laws conferred by

this Act is conferred subject to the conditions of the bye-laws being made after previous publication and in
the case of such bye-laws being made by [[the Corporation]] of their not taking effect until they have been
approved by the Government and published in the Official Gazette.

(2) The Government in approving a bye-law may make any change therein which appears to it to

be necessary.

(3) The Government may, after previous publication of its intention cancel any bye-law which it

has approved, and thereupon the bye-law shall cease to have effect.
